'''Treebrother''' is a honorific sometimes used when referring to [[Constructs#Nym|Nym]] or [[Ogier]]. Both Nym and Ogier spend much of their time and energy tending to nature, most notably in tending trees. Nym are seemingly made from various forms of plant life and have the ability to stimulate plant growth. Some Ogier are able to use [[treesinging]] to stimulate tree growth. Both Nym and Ogier were involved in [[Song of Growing#Seed Singing|Seed Singing]] in some way.

==Known Uses==

# [[Loial]] addresses [[Someshta]] as "Treebrother."{{ref/book|1|49}} Notably, Loial uses "Treebrother" in this context more like a name than a title or honorific.{{ref/book|1|53}}
# [[Selene]] addresses Loial as "''alantin''," which is an [[Old Tongue]] word for "brother." According to Loial, it "is short for ''tia avende alantin'',"{{ref/book|2|19}} meaning "Treebrother" and is a very formal address.
# The [[Aiel]] present at [[Stedding]] [[Tsofu]] when Rand and the others seek permission to use the Tsofu [[Waygate]] address the Ogier [[Juin]] as "Treebrother."{{ref/book|2|35}}
